meta.name: SSEVOH-DSL
meta.description: Operator-controlled contracts govern self-modification, keep approvals tied to their checked context, and prevent reuse of artifacts derived from withdrawn versions. Introduced in Governing Changes in Self-Evolving Agents, submitted to IEEE TSE.

releases.title: Manuscript submitted to IEEE TSE
releases.notes:
**Governing Changes in Self-Evolving Agents**

Majid Babaei. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering; not accepted or published. Introduces SSEVOH-DSL and Foundational Contracts for version-bound approval, dependency quarantine, withdrawal through recorded origins, and eligible recovery. Evaluated in one self-evolving host; broader portability remains untested. Submission confirmed by the author on November 13, 2026. No public manuscript or repository URL supplied.
